CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red set) is identified and presented with an explicit origin/organization field; the origin is reported separately from the red content.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the identified contents' organization/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names content sets (colour-tagged coordinate lists) for a current representational entry.

D.rationale: The content (red coordinates) and its status/origin are provided as separate fields for the same referent.

O.rationale: An explicit origin/representation field describes how the content entry is organized/represented (represented_time, origin kind).
